extracted.name: Sausage traybake with garlic butter croutons
extracted.description: Whip up something easy midweek like this all-in-one sausage traybake, topped with crunchy, herby croutons
ingredient_lines: 1 medium head of cauliflower cut into small florets and leaves chopped
1 head of broccoli cut into medium florets, stalk peeled and cut into chunks
2 tbsp chopped basil, parsley and thyme
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the sausages, cauliflower, broccoli and onion into a baking tray. Whisk the vinegar, honey, mustard, fennel seeds and oil together. Pour over the sausages and veg, and season. Roast for 25-30 mins until golden, sticky and glazed. Give everything a turn halfway through cooking.

Melt the butter, garlic and herbs with some seasoning in a bowl in the microwave or in a small pan. Toss in the bread cubes and toss well. Scatter the croutons over the traybake and bake for 5-10 mins more, until golden and crisp. Serve with potatoes, if you like.
